A breakfast plate of shredded hash browns topped with green salsa and diced tomato, with bacon and a very dark browned breakfast meat, likely sausage.

The allocated food coverage totals **73%** of the plate. Approximately **332 g and 823 kcal** is plausible for this visible portion of fried potatoes and fatty breakfast meats. The main uncertainties are the potatoes’ cooking-fat content and the identity of the dark meat.
